newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Wednesday, lifted by constant short-covering amid a view that deliveries at the spot expiry next week will be small, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 1.0 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark May was up 0.9 yen to 144.9 yen.
"Considering recent falls in rubber stocks, expectations of small deliveries at the expiry are emerging," one trader said.
Firmer Thai rubber offer prices to Japan were also cited as a supportive factor for the market, traders said.
